description:
Shaun Golden
MONMOUNTY COUNTY SHERIFF
NOTICE OF FORECLOSURE SALE
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
MONMOUTH COUNTY
CHANCERY DIVISION
Docket No. F00486025
Sheriff’s File # 26000270
PLAINTIFF – JPMorgan Chase Bank, National Association vs:
DEFENDANTS- Barry Wiener, et al.
By virtue of a writ of execution in the above stated action to me directed, I shall expose for sale at public vendue, at Monmouth County Sheriff’s Office Public Safety Center, 2500 Kozloski Road, in the township of Freehold, county of Monmouth, New Jersey, on
Monday, the 27th day of April, 2026
at 1 o’clock, P.M. prevailing time. The property to be sold is located in Middletown, in the County of Monmouth, State of New Jersey.
Lot Block Number if available: Lot and Block: Lot 56, Block 1117, Tax Map of Township of Middletown
COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
23 Majestic Avenue Middletown, NJ 07738
Dimensions of lot: 175' x 156.62'
Nearest cross street: Newman Springs Road
Superior Interests (if any): Any and all easements, covenants, restrictions and reservations of record; Any set of facts which an accurate survey and inspection would disclose; All unpaid municipal taxes, assessments and liens; Any unpaid assessment and any outstanding tax sale certificate; Rights of any party in possession/rights protected by the NJ Anti-Eviction Act; All Local County, State and Federal ordinances and regulations; Any condominium association lien granted priority by N.J.S.A 46:8B-21b; Any outstanding Condominium, PUD or Homeowner Association dues or fees; Rights of the United States of America, if any; The property is sold in its “AS IS” condition; Purchaser shall be responsible for Sheriff’s costs, commission, deed recording fees and realty transfer fees.
Township of Middletown Sewerage Authority holds a claim in the amount of $120.00 and $541.10 plus penalty as of 12/31/2025.
Property registration Fee- please contact the Township Clerk at 732-615-2014 for information and updates.
RT:F-NJ II LLC holds a tax sale certificate in the amount of $162.77 as of 02/02/2026.
Plaintiff's upset bid is $579,299.53 in accordance with the requirements of Section 12 of P.L. 1995, c. 244 (C.2A:50-64)as amended.
The property is reported to be vacant.
The full legal description can be found in the Office of the Clerk of Monmouth County in Mortgage Book OR-8609 page 8492.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
A full legal description of the premises can be found in the Office of The Sheriff of Monmouth County.
TERMS OF SALE: DEPOSIT: 20% of the bid amount at the time of sale. Balance due in 30 days. Cash (with a limit of $1,000.00) or cashier’s check only.
The approximate judgment amount is the sum of $571,350.11.
The judgment amount may be subject to further Orders of additional sums. The successful bidder will be responsible for all fees, commissions and costs of sale.
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice by publication.
Shaun Golden, Sheriff
DATED: February 24, 2026
Powers Kirn, LLC
308 Harper Drive Suite 210
P.O. Box 848
Moorestown, NJ 08057
856-802-1000
